description: GAMS Transient Stability-Constrained Optimal Power Flow Model of the IEEE 39 Bus Test Case Including Non-Synchronous Generation is a model or code deposit deposited in e-cienciaDatos by its authors Pablo Ledesma Larrea, Francisco Arrendondo Rodríguez (Universidad Carlos III de Madrid). This file is a supplementary material of the paper "Optimal curtailment of non-synchronous renewable generation in the island of Tenerife considering steady state and transient stability constraints". It contains a transient stability-constrained optimal power flow model written in GAMS. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. Formats: TXT. Size stated: 122077. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
